status: Mentor inheritance flow preserved; empty eligible archive learns from God through one ordinary Divine Power spin.

confirmed: Spin one previous character from the character database, then Weapon, Power or Best Stat.
If the selected category has multiple weapons, powers or tied best stats, pick exactly one randomly.
Best Stat gives +1 numeric point to the corresponding stat on the current character.
An empty selected category is zonk with no bonus; no reroll.
Inherited weapon/power uses the new character's normal mastery, not the mentor's mastery/enchantments.
If no completed prior character is available, Disciple learns from God and gets one Divine Power spin.
authority.existingPolicy: Unspecified odds are equal: mentors, three reward categories and candidates inside the selected category.
implementationInterpretations: The mentor database snapshot contains completed previous characters, one immutable record per character; current/in-progress characters are excluded.
One reward is copied as a new recipient-owned grant; the mentor's inventory is not consumed or changed.
The random candidate pick is internal and journaled, not an additional visible wheel.
Best-stat keys must be saved with an approved comparison profile; do not compare incomparable raw stat units.

contracts.order: Actual Disciple/reaction -> valid archive: nonempty mentor/category/internal-pick flow; empty eligible archive one ordinary Divine Power lesson from God -> Backstory.
contracts.mentor: Every eligible completed character has base weight 1. Use a snapshot captured before saving the current character. No stronger-mentor rarity, race exclusion, category availability filter or re-dispatch of mentor Race/Archetype events.
contracts.category: Weapon : Power : Best Stat = 1:1:1, each 1/3, regardless of empty weapon/power inventory. Select exactly one category once.
contracts.candidate: Uniform among actual owned weapon/power instances in that category, including distinct same-definition instances; Best Stat uniform among unique tied best-stat keys. Singleton gives that one result; zero weapon/power candidates is zonk. Do not select another category or give every candidate. Current power candidates exclude already-owned ordinary canonical definitions before the internal random pick; if none remain the chosen category is zonk.
contracts.weapon: Create one new weapon instance from the selected intrinsic definition and bounded bindings/limitations. Copy no donor mastery, enchantments, stat effects or source-scoped bonuses. Queue recipient per-weapon normal mastery; compatible effective Master+ can later receive Enchant once.
contracts.power: Create one ordinary power grant with the selected intrinsic definition and bounded bindings/limitations. Use recipient single common Power Mastery; do not copy donor mastery bonuses or a God Authority maximum override. Intrinsic ability constraints remain. No Power Enchant or extra mastery spin.
contracts.bestStat: Use archived bestStatIds under bestStatComparisonProfileId. Multiple tied keys are equally eligible. Give only +1 numeric point on the selected key after immutable recipient base; do not copy the mentor's stat value, tier, scale, modifiers or conditional effects.
contracts.ownership: Existing recipient grants remain; copied grant survives later main Weapon/Power None. Preserve bounded item/ability parameters, not a complete mentor package, summoned mentor, body, vehicle, title, followers or race identity.
contracts.emptyDatabase: A valid empty eligible archive uses the fixed God-mentor fallback: one power-divine acquisition then Backstory, no mentor/category spin, no synthetic archived character. Missing archive provider is still configuration, not a claim that it is empty.
contracts.configuration: Database storage, catalog bindings and best-stat comparison profile must be configured before production. Missing or invalid archive fields are configuration/input errors; never infer best stat from incomparable raw values or future outcomes.
contracts.ledger: Freeze archive, selected mentor record, category and equal candidate pool before seeded sampling. Commit each actual spin once and internal pick once; grant/effect key is the Disciple invocation. Resume uses snapshots, without a fresh database query, redraw or duplicate reward.
contracts.reaction: Nonempty archive: mentor and category actual visible spins. Empty eligible archive: one actual Divine lesson spin, fixed God mentor label. Reveal only committed facts; internal picks/fixed labels are not extra actual spins or Shrek triggers.

archiveContract.snapshotBoundary: Provider creates an immutable view before the current character is stored; completed status is complete. Duplicate completed character IDs are invalid, not extra weight.
archiveContract.scope: Projection keeps intrinsic definition/bindings/limitations only. Normalized best-stat profile may be supplied later if category is Best Stat; missing profile is needs_configuration, not zonk. No actual prior-character database is fabricated by this design.

runtimeInterface.sampling: Pure plans only; future engine uses seeded RNG and stores actual mentor/category spins and the internal candidate pick.
runtimeInterface.mutation: Helper emits one ledger-keyed reward; engine atomically deduplicates/applies it and schedules normal mastery. No direct mutation or database I/O.

resultContext.afterMentor: Nama dan snapshot mentor sudah diketahui; warisannya belum.
resultContext.afterCategory: Tampilkan kategori aktual; pilih satu kandidat dalam kategori itu.
resultContext.futureResults: Backstory, Size, base stat dan mastery karakter baru belum diketahui.

godMentorFallback.when: Valid archive snapshot contains no eligible completed prior character.
godMentorFallback.mastery: Recipient one shared Power Mastery; no God base9 override, scarcity, Concept, followers, race/body or full God event.
godMentorFallback.reaction: Disciple. Database kosong, langsung belajar dari God.
